1.title: I was a Claude hater. Fable 5.2 changed my mind.
1.author: How I AI
1.hook: Hands-on comparison of Claude Fable 5.2 vs Opus 5.5 across concrete tasks: video generation from text, spatial reasoning (furniture assembly), game development, and product pipeline re-architecture. Names specific wins (animation without slide-look), specific losses (web design), and routing heuristics between models.

2.title: Why Agents Break Traditional Databases | Andy Pavlo
2.author: MTS
2.hook: Andy Pavlo (CMU prof, ClickHouse VP) discusses why AI agents break legacy databases—nonstop query volumes, "vibe coding," ClickHouse's Postgres expansion via Xata, and predictions for agent-written databases.

1.title: AI Design Bottlenecks Shift in Next 2 Years | McCord
1.author: MTS
1.hook: Cameron McCord (Nominal CEO, $240M raised) argues hardware validation is the primary bottleneck for frontier models; discusses why software-first AI approaches fail in hardware engineering and how agentic workflows are reshaping aerospace/defense supply chains.
